description: Na₂CaPO₄F crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.46 Å. There is one shorter (2.36 Å) and one longer (2.48 Å) Na-F bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.50 Å. There is one shorter (2.34 Å) and one longer (2.45 Å) Na-F bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form distorted NaO₄F₂ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent CaO₅F₂ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CaO₄F₂ octahedra, and  a faceface with one CaO₅F₂ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 13°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.52 Å. There is one shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.38 Å) Na-F bond length. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.53 Å. There is one shorter (2.45 Å) and one longer (2.54 Å) Na-F bond length. There are two inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded to five O and two F atoms to form distorted CaO₅F₂ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CaO₄F₂ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-73°. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.59 Å. There is one shorter (2.35 Å) and one longer (2.40 Å) Ca-F bond length. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form distorted CaO₄F₂ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one CaO₅F₂ pentagonal bipyramid, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄F₂ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CaO₅F₂ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 13°. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.40 Å. There is one shorter (2.31 Å) and one longer (2.32 Å) Ca-F bond length. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent CaO₅F₂ pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one CaO₅F₂ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-69°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with three equivalent CaO₄F₂ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one CaO₅F₂ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-66°. There are three shorter (1.56 Å) and one longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond length. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂CaP tetrahedra that share corners with six FNa₄Ca₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-74°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom to form ONa₂CaP tetrahedra that share corners with six FNa₄Ca₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-65°. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to four Na and two Ca atoms to form FNa₄Ca₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂CaP tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent FNa₄Ca₂ octahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to four Na and two Ca atoms to form FNa₄Ca₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂CaP tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent FNa₄Ca₂ octahedra.
